## Objective
Fix four validated-but-broken config paths: (1) tracker.assignee passes validation but extraction drops it so polling runs unfiltered; (2) merge.mode is validated against the wrong section map; (3) allowlist config extraction silently drops unknown/typo'd keys; (4) workflow-load failure silently falls back to full defaults.

## Design summary
Conventions are pre-decided: unknown keys log a warning naming the key and its section; workflow-load failure logs at error level and makes the fallback-to-defaults explicit in output. Do not add new config keys and do not rewrite the validation framework - wire what exists. Defect sites: config.ex:1650 (assignee validated) vs config.ex:1208-1220 (extraction drops it); config.ex:1698 (merge.mode wrong section); extract_* helpers + config.ex:1152-1156 (silent drops / silent fallback).

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/config.ex, elixir/lib/rondo/orchestrator.ex (ONLY the point where tracker.assignee is applied to polling), new/updated tests under elixir/test/.
Exclude: all other modules.

## Constraints
If the assignee application point turns out to live outside config.ex/orchestrator.ex, PAUSE and report - do not widen scope. No git push or PR creation - local branch/diff only. Environment: mix resolves via mise shims; if mix is not found, prepend $HOME/.local/share/mise/shims to PATH. Work test-first: one failing test per acceptance bullet before fixing. If any acceptance criterion is ambiguous, pause and ask.

## Verification
All from the repo root:
1. cd elixir && mix test  (new tests: assignee applied to polling; merge.mode validated in own section; unknown key warns; load failure loud)
2. cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted
3. cd elixir && mix credo --strict
Known flaky: OrchestratorStatusTest (RON-31) - fixed-seed verify against main before treating a failure as real.
dependencies: config.ex and orchestrator.ex present at pinned base (probed in authoring session)

success_criteria: cd elixir && mix test exits 0 including one new test per acceptance bullet

output_expectations.summary: Which of the four silent paths were fixed where, with the new diagnostics shown.
output_expectations.next_step: ready-for-review handoff; human reviews and opens the PR

allow: Edit files within the include scope and add/update tests under elixir/test/
Run the configured gates and slice verification commands
Create/commit on a local work branch (vic/ron-137-*)
ask: Any edit outside the include scope
deny: git push, PR creation, or any remote write
Adding new config keys or rewriting the validation framework

routing.reason: mechanical wiring with pinned defect sites
